contract.known_boundary: Local process execution boundary with argv, cwd, environment, stdout/stderr streaming, cancellation and exit status.
contract.detail_gap: Security policy for executables, shell use, inherited environment, process trees, limits and privilege boundaries is not authoritative yet.

candidates.independence: Dart project implementation; independent from process_run.

fit.stdout_stderr_streaming: strong via Process returned by start
fit.cancellation: strong primitive via process kill / killPid
fit.shell_surface: optional runInShell flag rather than shell-first API

candidates.vulnerability_gate: NOT_ANALYZED because security review is required first

fit.macos_sandbox_note: upstream documents sandbox entitlement implications for process execution

candidates.vulnerability_gate: NOT_ANALYZED because security review is required first

decision.reason: Both expose the intended high-impact process primitive. Automated review correctly remains fail-closed; the narrower mockable ProcessManager is the cleaner default boundary pending explicit policy and sandbox validation.
